system.description:
At 3rd level, your experience with armor itself has taken your knowledge from theoretical to practical. Your modifications to your own armor or shields allow you to treat it as if it had the low maintenance (expertise die) trait. If your armor or shield is already low maintenance, you instead gain advantage to repairs. In addition, you do not take disadvantage to stealth checks from medium armor.

Finally, if you sacrifice a shield to negate a critical hit, the shield is only damaged rather than broken. If your shield is damaged before you sacrifice it, however, it becomes broken.
